assessment: A strong, economically sound recommendation that correctly prioritizes a $95 free-shipping threshold over a 15% sitewide discount, with accurate margin arithmetic and a profit-per-visitor primary metric. Four of five judges converged on 7-9 across all criteria, noting the same consistent gaps: no numeric decision threshold or confidence level, no sample-size/traffic feasibility check, and no fallback for small operators lacking A/B testing tools. The main recurring improvement requests are a break-even lift calculation and concrete statistical decision rules.
judge_agreement: Four judges (anthropic, openai, deepseek, qwen) agreed closely, all scoring practicality 7-8 and specificity 8-9, and converging on the same shortcomings (no statistical thresholds, no traffic/power check, missing seasonality and low-traffic contingencies). The google judge was a consistent high outlier, awarding 10 on all three criteria with 'no improvement needed,' diverging from every other evaluator's identified gaps. No rule errors were flagged by any judge.
